Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.subtitle: Short and honest – so you know what this site is for.
Faq.q1: When does the Croatia national team play next?
Faq.a1Live: {fixture} on {when}. Dates and results are on the live board and in the national-team section.
Faq.a1Fallback: As soon as an international is in the feed it appears in the hero and national-team section. We list squads only after official nomination.
Faq.q2: Where can I watch matches legally?
Faq.a2: We do not host broadcasts and only name channels when a live transmission is editorially confirmed. Otherwise we link official homepages (e.g. HRT). No illegal streams, no VPN sales.
Faq.q3: Which Croatian players have a match today or this week?
Faq.a3: The “Croatians at a glance” table lists next club fixture, last result and form. The tracker below has photos, status and more appearances.
Faq.q4: Are the news copies of other articles?
Faq.a4: No. We show the headline plus our own short teaser and a link to the original. No framing, no full-text scraping.
Faq.a5: No. It is an independent editorial information site. Official sources remain HNS, clubs and licensed broadcasters.

Legal.contactOnlyEmail: Contact by email only (no residential address published):
Legal.impressumBody: This site provides general information on fixtures, editorial notes and aggregated headlines with links to the original source. We do not host broadcasts, offer illegal streams or republish third-party full texts (no framing). Linked content, rights and availability remain solely with the respective publishers.
Legal.noPersonalData: Note: For privacy reasons we do not publish private residential addresses or full names of natural persons on this public notice. Authorities and claimants with a legitimate interest may request required details by email.
Legal.privacyIntro: We take privacy seriously. This notice explains what data may be processed when you use the site.
Legal.privacyDataGeo: Approximate region/country (geo IP via headers or lookup) – only to show regional TV tips, not stored for advertising.
Legal.privacyDataLocal: Browser storage (localStorage), e.g. favourites, theme, votes on provider links, optional status reports – stays on your device.
Legal.privacyDataPush: Push notifications only after your explicit browser consent (optional).
Legal.privacyDataLogs: Technical hosting logs (e.g. Vercel): IP, time, user agent – for security and debugging, limited by the host.
Legal.privacyDataThird: When you open external links, the providers’ privacy policies apply. Image URLs may trigger third-party CDN requests.
Legal.privacyPurposeBody: Running the site, editorial content, optional favourites, regional TV tips, security. Currently no advertising and no affiliate programmes.
Legal.privacyNoAdsBody: At launch we do not run ads or affiliate links (including VPN). If that changes, we will disclose it and update this notice.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: Depending on applicable law (e.g. GDPR) you may have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and complaint to a supervisory authority. Contact us by email.
Legal.privacyUpdate: As of August 2026. We may update this notice; the published version applies.
Legal.termsIntro: By using this website you accept the following terms.
Legal.termsServiceBody: Croatia Sport Live is an editorial information service about fixtures, news and official providers. It is not a streaming host and not an official federation or club site.
Legal.termsLinksBody: Links lead to third-party sites (TV providers, news media). Availability, pricing, geo-restrictions and content are solely their responsibility. Headlines appear only as short teasers with a source link – we do not embed third-party articles. Channel tips are non-binding.
Legal.termsUgcBody: Features such as favourites, votes or status suggestions help improve tips. Users cannot change system status themselves – only suggest. Abuse is prohibited. We may delete or ignore submissions.
Legal.termsLiabilityBody: To the extent permitted by law we are not liable for damages from use of the site or third-party services. Live data and TV tips may be incomplete or outdated.
